method_summary: Read exact issue subjects from the #487 pinned scope, match each stable atlas ID to the current containing GeoJSON and its source-member ID, match all four ECO_ID/name/license records in the retained RESOLVE extract, and confirm the San Bernardino ADM2 and 2024 county-equivalent identity separately. Recommend source-role/rationale text only; do not edit or regenerate geometry.
uncertainties: The role classification is supported by RESOLVE's ecological/natural-boundary description. The inherited 2018/current and 2024 overlays are only screens and are not remeasured or converted into exact legal boundary claims here.
Census Places and GSHHG data remain incomplete screens for unincorporated settlements, detached land, islands, coastline and full county remainders.
County identity, ecological ecoregion membership and historical/political ownership are separate attributes; this proposal makes no sovereignty or government claim.
